# 3. Results

## 3.1 Study Selection

```{r prisma, echo=FALSE}
# PRISMA flow diagram would go here
cat("Records identified: [N]
Records after deduplication: [N]
Full-text articles assessed: [N]
Studies included in meta-analysis: [N]")
```

## 3.2 Study Characteristics

```{r data-loading}
# Load your data
data <- data.frame(
  study = paste0("Study ", 1:10),
  effect = c(0.5, 0.3, 0.7, 0.4, 0.6, 0.5, 0.2, 0.8, 0.4, 0.5),
  se = c(0.15, 0.20, 0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.17, 0.22, 0.15, 0.19, 0.16),
  year = 2014:2023,
  sample_size = sample(50:200, 10),
  quality = sample(5:10, 10, replace = TRUE)
)
```

```{r study-table}
# Table of included studies
kable(data, caption = "Characteristics of Included Studies")
```

**Total Studies:** `r nrow(data)`
**Total Participants:** `r sum(data$sample_size)` (if applicable)
**Publication Years:** `r min(data$year)` to `r max(data$year)`

## 3.3 Main Meta-Analysis

```{r main-analysis}
# Conduct main meta-analysis
result <- cbamm_fast(data, method = "REML")
print(result)
```

### Key Findings

- **Pooled Effect Size:** `r sprintf("%.3f", result$estimate)`
  (95% CI: `r sprintf("%.3f", result$ci_lower)` to `r sprintf("%.3f", result$ci_upper)`)
- **P-value:** `r sprintf("%.4f", result$p_value)`
- **Heterogeneity (I²):** `r sprintf("%.1f%%", result$I2)`
- **Between-study variance (τ²):** `r sprintf("%.3f", result$tau2)`

**Interpretation:** [Interpret the findings in context]

### Forest Plot

```{r forest-plot, fig.height=7}
# Create forest plot
gg_forest_plot(data, result = result, show_weights = TRUE,
               title = "Forest Plot of Effect Sizes")
```

## 3.4 Heterogeneity Assessment

```{r heterogeneity}
cat(sprintf("Cochran's Q = %.2f (df = %d, p = %.4f)\n",
            result$Q, result$k - 1,
            1 - pchisq(result$Q, result$k - 1)))
cat(sprintf("I² = %.1f%% (95%% CI: [calculate])\n", result$I2))
cat(sprintf("τ² = %.3f\n", result$tau2))
```

**Interpretation:**
[Interpret heterogeneity level:
- I² < 25%: Low heterogeneity
- I² 25-75%: Moderate heterogeneity
- I² > 75%: High heterogeneity]

## 3.5 Publication Bias

### Funnel Plot

```{r funnel-plot}
gg_funnel_plot(data, result = result, show_contours = TRUE,
               title = "Funnel Plot for Publication Bias Assessment")
```

### Statistical Tests

```{r publication-bias}
# Egger's test
egger <- egger_test(data)
cat(sprintf("Egger's test: intercept = %.3f, p = %.4f\n",
            egger$intercept, egger$p_value))

# PET-PEESE
pet_peese_result <- pet_peese(data)
print(pet_peese_result)

# Trim and fill
tf <- trim_fill(data)
cat(sprintf("\nTrim-and-fill: %d studies imputed\n", tf$n_imputed))
```

**Interpretation:** [Interpret publication bias assessment]

## 3.6 Sensitivity Analysis

### Leave-One-Out Analysis

```{r loo-analysis}
loo <- leave_one_out(data, method = "REML")
kable(loo, caption = "Leave-One-Out Sensitivity Analysis")
```

### Influence Diagnostics

```{r influence}
influence <- influence_diagnostics(data)
print(influence)

# Baujat plot
baujat_plot(data, main = "Baujat Plot: Heterogeneity vs Influence")
```

## 3.7 Subgroup Analyses

```{r subgroup, eval=FALSE}
# If you have subgroups
data$subgroup <- sample(c("Subgroup A", "Subgroup B"), nrow(data), replace = TRUE)
subgroup_result <- subgroup_analysis(data, subgroup_var = "subgroup")
print(subgroup_result)
```

## 3.8 Meta-Regression

```{r metaregression, eval=FALSE}
# If you have moderators
metareg <- meta_regression(data, formula = ~ year + quality)
print(metareg)

# Visualize
gg_metareg_plot(data, moderator = "year", show_bubble = TRUE)
```

## 3.9 Prediction Interval

```{r prediction-interval}
# Calculate prediction interval
pi <- prediction_interval(data, method = "REML")
cat(sprintf("Prediction Interval: %.3f to %.3f\n", pi$pi_lower, pi$pi_upper))
cat("\nInterpretation: We expect the true effect in a new study to fall
within this range 95% of the time.\n")
```
